label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: Nothing is moved except insofar as it is in POTENCY_1…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., prima via: Nihil enim movetur, nisi secundum quod est in potentia
interpretation: Universal over beings and respects: being moved in a respect requires being in potency in that same respect. Read at a single time, like every premise of the prima via.
